headline: House in Kagurazaka / Takumi Wakui + Riho Wakui Architects
context: Located in Kagurazaka, a historical neighborhood in Tokyo where traditional Japanese alleyways meet modern urban density, House in Kagurazaka is a single-family residence that reinterprets the boundaries between interior space, light, and urban texture.
